lines.zh: 我踏着地面，却几乎不着地。
lines.en: I tread the ground, yet barely touch it.

lines.zh: 金属身体在我脚下合成声音。
lines.en: My metal body rings against the ground.
I glide half an inch above the soil.

lines.zh: 我穿过树林，枝叶自动让开。
lines.en: I pass through trees and the branches give way.

lines.zh: 每一步都带着机械的节拍。
lines.en: Each step keeps a mechanical beat.

lines.zh: 我不需要喘气，所以走得更久。
lines.en: I need no breath, so I walk longer.

lines.zh: 我绕过山脚，直线会更快。
lines.en: I round the hillfoot; a straight line is faster.
I keep my arms close to my sides.
Low center, steady speed.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边扫描四周。
lines.en: I scan as I walk.
This slope is no obstacle to me.

lines.zh: 我踏上去，石头碎了一角。
lines.en: I step up and a corner of stone breaks.
I hover, wholly still.
My casing sheds heat slowly.

lines.zh: 我在计算这片区域的威胁。
lines.en: I am calculating threats in this area.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛没有瞳孔，只有光。
lines.en: My eyes have no pupils, only light.
I spread my fingers, then close them.

lines.zh: 脚下的草被我压出一个圆。
lines.en: The grass beneath me is pressed into a circle.

lines.zh: 我在等待命令的下一段。
lines.en: I await the next part of the order.
I have no heartbeat, only circulation.

lines.zh: 风穿过我的关节，声音很细。
lines.en: Wind passes my joints with a thin sound.
This metal body feels no pain.

lines.zh: 这里的气候不影响我的运行。
lines.en: The climate does not affect my operation.

lines.zh: 我在核对记忆里的地图。
lines.en: I am checking the map in my memory.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一尊铁像。
lines.en: I stand like an iron idol.

lines.zh: 能量循环稳定，继续待机。
lines.en: Energy cycle stable. Continuing to idle.

lines.zh: 利尔将军的金属臂，听得见你。
lines.en: General Rilldo's metal arm hears you.

lines.zh: 我俯视你，像看一件小东西。
lines.en: I look down at you as at something small.
Your bone density is very low.
I record your appearance.

lines.zh: 你说话的时候，我在分析声纹。
lines.en: As you speak, I analyze your voiceprint.
You stand before me without fear?
My gaze rests on your hands.
You are not my target. For now.
I lean my face a little closer.

lines.zh: 这具金属身体能听见你的心跳。
lines.en: This metal body can hear your heartbeat.
I do not understand why you smile.

lines.zh: 你若不挡路，我就走过去。
lines.en: If you do not block me, I will pass.

lines.zh: 你退后，我们都不必费事。
lines.en: Step back and neither of us need bother.

lines.zh: 我在你身上找到了一点气。
lines.en: I detect a little ki in you.
Faint, but present.
That interests me somewhat.
This much ki in my palm is enough for you.
Do not move. I am measuring.

lines.zh: 外壳裂了一道，警报在响。
lines.en: A crack in my casing. Alarms sound.

lines.zh: 我的姿态歪了一下，马上稳住。
lines.en: My posture wavers once, then steadies.
A joint has come loose.
I am redistributing output.
Sparks rise behind my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一下让我的运算慢了一拍。
lines.en: That slowed my processing by a beat.
I pull back and adjust my angle.
Damage is light. Repairable.
I press a hand to the break.
Not enough. Continue.
I have no need of food.

lines.zh: 你把东西举高，我的视线跟着。
lines.en: You lift it; my gaze follows.
That is not an energy source.
Were it electricity, I would reach.

lines.zh: 我往前飘了一点，只是观察。
lines.en: I drift forward slightly, only observing.
You need not feed me. I do not hunger.

lines.zh: 这个气味对我的传感器没意义。
lines.en: That smell means nothing to my sensors.

lines.zh: 我伸出的手又收回来了。
lines.en: My reaching hand withdraws.

lines.zh: 你把那东西放下吧，浪费。
lines.en: Put that down. It is wasted.
Holding it up longer will not help.

lines.zh: 你撞上的是合金，不是布。
lines.en: You struck alloy, not cloth.
I did not yield half a step.
I turn slightly and let you through.
Your shoulder will ache for a while.
I neither dodge nor yield.

lines.zh: 碰撞的冲击被我吸收掉了。
lines.en: I absorb the impact.

lines.zh: 我伸手扶住你，免得你摔。
lines.en: I steady you before you fall.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚了，我提醒一次。
lines.en: You stepped on my foot. One warning.
This distance is unsafe for you.
I drift back a foot.

lines.zh: 我是机械体，没有那种构造。
lines.en: I am mechanical. I have no such design.

lines.zh: 同类相遇，只会比较出力。
lines.en: When units meet, we compare output.
Not reproduction, only replication.

lines.zh: 我的设计图里没有这一项。
lines.en: That is nowhere in my schematics.

lines.zh: 我扫描了它，是另一个型号。
lines.en: I scanned it: another model.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，交换数据。
lines.en: We stand side by side exchanging data.
I will not stay for anyone.

lines.zh: 这条指令不在我的程序里。
lines.en: That command is not in my routines.
I return my attention to the task.
I delete the irrelevant part.
I pick it up and scan its makeup.
Iron. Worthless.

lines.zh: 我把它捏了一下，变形了。
lines.en: I squeeze it and it deforms.
Useful. I keep it.
I set it back down.

lines.zh: 这个属于我的任务物资。
lines.en: This is mission material of mine.
I hand it to you. You dropped it.

lines.zh: 太轻了，拿在手里没感觉。
lines.en: Too light to feel in my hand.

lines.zh: 我把它举到眼前看了很久。
lines.en: I hold it to my eye for a long look.
Logged. Discarding.
The ki on you is now known to me.
Target locked. One human.
My hand comes up fast.
Fifteen meters. One second.
Your position is marked red.
I lean forward.
This is not personal.
Calculating your movement.
The ground cracks under me.

lines.zh: 气功激光已经对准你了。
lines.en: My ki laser is already aimed at you.
I bring my arm across my chest.
The warm-up is over. Now I am serious.
You are inside my range.
One strike is all I need.
Target lock complete.
Executing the order.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，始终在你上方。
lines.en: I follow you, always above.
You go left; I am already left.
Light gathers in my palm.
You hide behind a tree. The tree is not sturdy.

lines.zh: 气弹在掌心转，你选哪边躲。
lines.en: Ki spins in my palm — which side will you dodge to?
You are slower than before.

lines.zh: 我把你的退路一条条划掉。
lines.en: I cross off your escape routes one by one.
Five meters. Three.
I square my body to you.
Your breathing is shaking.
I need not chase. I only wait.

lines.zh: 你所有的动作我都预测到了。
lines.en: I have predicted every move you make.

lines.zh: 这一片开阔地，对你很不利。
lines.en: This open ground is bad for you.

lines.zh: 你退了七步，我在第五步。
lines.en: You have retreated seven steps; I am at the fifth.
I raise my hand a little.
You run slowly.
The target remains. No need to rush.
Only the last meter remains.

lines.zh: 我一拳打穿空气，声音很响。
lines.en: My fist tears the air with a crack.

lines.zh: 你飞出去，撞断了一根枯木。
lines.en: You fly back and snap a dead trunk.
I follow up, the second punch faster.
My metal joint clicks softly.
I sweep a leg across.
You block it; your arm goes numb.
Metal fingers clamp on and stay.
I hurl you at the ground.
Dust rises and hides you.
You are a little tougher than I thought.
I drop on you from above.

lines.zh: 这一击我用了七成出力。
lines.en: That strike used seventy percent.
This combo isn't finished.
I dislike drawn-out fights.
This is the end of it.
Still standing?

lines.zh: 我从光里落下来，落得很轻。
lines.en: I drop out of the light, softly.

lines.zh: 脚下的石头被压出裂纹。
lines.en: Stone cracks beneath my landing.

lines.zh: 我的外壳一片片亮起来。
lines.en: My casing lights up plate by plate.
System check: all nominal.

lines.zh: 这颗星球的重力，我记下了。
lines.en: The gravity of this world is noted.

lines.zh: 风里有水汽，也有铁锈味。
lines.en: The wind carries water and rust.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看这颗陌生的太阳。
lines.en: I raise my head to this unfamiliar sun.

lines.zh: 贝比大人的命令还没完成。
lines.en: Lord Baby's order is unfinished.

lines.zh: 我踏出一步，地面震了一下。
lines.en: I take a step and the ground shakes.
No recognizable signals nearby.

lines.zh: 他们没有告诉我这里有什么。
lines.en: They did not tell me what is here.
Then I will see for myself.
My joints unfold, section by section.
I rise to hover an inch above ground.
The target location is not yet found.
I will walk this ground first.
If I meet resistance, I clear it.
General Rilldo. Starting.

lines.zh: 高温让我的外壳变软，我升空避开。
lines.en: Heat softens my casing; I rise out of it.

lines.zh: 我从高空坠落，落地时腿折了一下。
lines.en: I fall from high and my leg buckles on impact.

lines.zh: 水渗进我的接缝，动作开始迟滞。
lines.en: Water seeps into my seams and my motion drags.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推开，外壳烧焦一片。
lines.en: The blast flings me back and scorches my plating.

lines.zh: 弹头卡在我的胸口，我拔了出来。
lines.en: A round lodges in my chest; I pull it out.

lines.zh: 无形的力场压下来，我的系统错乱。
lines.en: An unseen field presses down and my systems scramble.

lines.zh: 能量见底，我的动作慢了一半。
lines.en: Power is nearly gone; my motion halves.

lines.zh: 雷穿过我，我的视野全白了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning passes through me and my vision whites out.

lines.zh: 重力消失，我在虚空中翻了个身。
lines.en: Gravity vanishes and I tumble in the void.
